evidence.detail: person() handles both /people/<mtgo_username>/ and /people/id/<int:person_id>/ routes but never redirects from the ID-based route to the vanity URL
archetype() serves content for numeric archetype_id without redirecting to the name-based URL; load_archetype at data/archetype.py:28-39 distinguishes int vs string inputs
load_person() already fetches the mtgo_username via ps.load_person_by_id, making the redirect straightforward for users who have one

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/people.py person(): after loading p when called with person_id and p.mtgo_username is not None, return redirect(url_for('.person', mtgo_username=p.mtgo_username), code=301). In decksite/controllers/metagame.py archetype(): after loading a, if archetype_id.isdigit() return redirect(url_for('.archetype', archetype_id=a.name.replace(' ', '+')), code=301). Each change is 3-5 lines.
triage.notes: Issue comment flags that Goldfish/Tapped-Out-only users have no vanity URL to redirect to; the fix handles this gracefully by only redirecting when mtgo_username is present. Archetypes always have names so no edge case there.
